item.text:
The dashboard’s partial pre-rendered shell now shows its heading and labeled placeholders for the cards, chart, and invoices. The data fetch runs inside a Suspense boundary in [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx), with a shared [dashboard skeleton](/workspace/app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx) also used during route loading. I enabled partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts).

The production build and TypeScript check pass. The generated HTML contains the dashboard shell, and Next.js still reports `/` as partially pre-rendered. Live data was not verified because the existing fetch points to `api.example.com`.
